title: Tag 相邻交换（库内储备）

standard.summary: tag_swap_rate 以概率交换相邻 tag 对。当前为库函数/配置储备，生产 CaptionDataset._process_caption 默认路径未接线（default 0.0 无副作用）。
standard.effect: 配置存在且库函数 caption_augment.swap_adjacent_pairs 可用；生产训练路径本包不读取该字段。
standard.whenToUse: 仅开发/实验通过 apply_caption_augments 库入口时；产品训练请用 shuffle_caption 或 tag_group_shuffle。
standard.avoidWhen: 期望生产训练自动生效时——尚未接线，请勿依赖。

standard_en.summary: tag_swap_rate swaps adjacent tag pairs with a given probability. It is currently a library function plus a reserved configuration field; the production default path in CaptionDataset._process_caption does not read it (the default of 0.0 has no side effects).
standard_en.effect: The configuration exists and the library function caption_augment.swap_adjacent_pairs is available; the production training path in this package does not read the field.
standard_en.whenToUse: Only for development or experiments through the apply_caption_augments library entry point; for product training use shuffle_caption or tag_group_shuffle.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you expect it to take effect automatically in production training -- it is not wired up, so do not rely on it.

advanced.principle: 库语义：遍历 tag 列表，每对相邻 tag 以 swap_rate 概率交换。局部扰动而非全局打乱。
advanced.intervention: 未挂入 dataset_loader 生产路径；见 devtools/docs/caption_ghost_field_audit.md。
advanced.expectedImpact: 接线前：零。接线后：轻微额外正则化。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 shuffle_caption 语义重叠；本包明确 reserve 后置。

advanced_en.principle: Library semantics: iterate the tag list and swap each adjacent pair with probability swap_rate. Local perturbation rather than global shuffling.
advanced_en.intervention: Not wired into the dataset_loader production path; see devtools/docs/caption_ghost_field_audit.md.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Before wiring: zero. After wiring: slight extra regularization.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Semantics overlap with shuffle_caption; this package is explicitly reserved for later.
